description: Expose FormIdentifierExists for HTTP 422 responses whose errors[0].code is form_identifier_exists on CreateEnterpriseConnection and UpdateEnterpriseConnection. Enterprise connection names are unique across a Clerk instance, and a create or update that reuses one fails with 422 { errors: [{ code: "form_identifier_exists", meta: { param_name: "name" } }] }, the envelope Clerk's Backend API error catalogue documents for form_identifier_exists (https://clerk.com/docs/guides/development/errors/backend-api). The spec only declares a generic 422, so the code a caller needs to recover (pick another name) is lost: the REST protocol keeps a numeric code only. Follows the body-matcher approach of platform/resource-not-found.patch.json (#702 guidance). Generic UnprocessableEntity stays the fallback for other 422 bodies. Not yet confirmed with a live probe.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The identifier is already taken, e.g. an enterprise connection name in use elsewhere on the instance (Clerk form_identifier_exists, HTTP 422).
